correctness.rationale: The normalized positive principal mixed Neumann–Dirichlet eigenmode makes conditional survival exp(-lambda int D_J dt), so Feynman–Kac gives the symmetric positive 2x2 killing matrix. Explicit inversion yields m=(1+2s)/(1+2s-delta²), c=1+2delta²/(1+2s)². With a=1-1/m and e=c-1, the inverse delta=sqrt(2)a/sqrt(e), s=a/e-1/2 has the exact image m>1, 2a²<e<2a; both endpoints are excluded. A new SymPy independent inverse/moment calculation matched the exact formulas. Labels exchange and singular limits are specified.
